def preserve_outputs(out,evidence,report):
    """Copy each derived output independently; retain the complete owned tree."""
    result=dict(copied={},excluded_roots=[],complete=False,owned_outputs_retained=True,
                retained_output_path=str(out),artifact_required=True)
    report["output_preservation"]=result;before=len(report["terminal_errors"])
    def visit(directory):
        entries=c.attempt(report,"enumerate:"+str(directory.relative_to(out)),
                          lambda:sorted(directory.iterdir()))
        if entries is None:return
        for path in entries:
            relative=path.relative_to(out)
            def one():
                f.require(not path.is_symlink(),"evidence symlink")
                if path.is_dir():

                        result["excluded_roots"].append(relative.as_posix());return
                    visit(path);return

                pin=f.file_digest(path)

                    published=report.get("native_publication",{}).get("files",{})
                    f.require(published.get(relative.as_posix())==pin,"large output not permanently preserved")
                    result.setdefault("complete_large_outputs_in_native_capsule",{})[relative.as_posix()]=pin

                f.write_new(dest,path.read_bytes())
                f.require(f.file_digest(dest)==pin,"preserved output bytes")
                result["copied"][relative.as_posix()]=pin
            c.attempt(report,"preserve:"+relative.as_posix(),one)

    row=dict(label=label,argv=argv,returncode=None);report["commands"].append(row)
    before=time.monotonic();first_error=len(report["terminal_errors"]);p=None;primary=None
    try:
        with (OUT/(label+".stdout")).open("xb")as so,(OUT/(label+".stderr")).open("xb")as se:
            p=subprocess.Popen(argv,stdout=so,stderr=se,start_new_session=True,
              env={**os.environ,"LC_ALL":"C.UTF-8","PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE":"1"})
            p.wait(timeout=timeout);row["returncode"]=p.returncode
            c.require(p.returncode==0,label+" failed")
    except BaseException as exc:
        primary=exc;row["error"]=c.error_record(label,exc)
    finally:
        if p is not None:
            def signal_if_live(sig):
                if p.poll()is None:os.killpg(p.pid,sig)
            def wait_if_live():
                if p.poll()is None:p.wait(timeout=10)
            # A failed stop cannot suppress the independent wait/kill/reap attempts.
            c.attempt(report,label+":stop",lambda:signal_if_live(signal.SIGTERM))
            c.attempt(report,label+":wait-after-stop",wait_if_live)
            c.attempt(report,label+":kill-if-live",lambda:signal_if_live(signal.SIGKILL))
            c.attempt(report,label+":wait-after-kill",wait_if_live)
            def terminal():
                row["returncode"]=p.poll();c.require(row["returncode"]is not None,"child remains live")
            c.attempt(report,label+":terminal-child",terminal)
        row["elapsed_seconds"]=time.monotonic()-before
        c.attempt(report,label+":progress",lambda:write("multilayer-inner-progress.json",report))
    if primary is not None:raise primary
    c.require(len(report["terminal_errors"])==first_error,label+" terminal errors")

        report["cgroup_initial"]=usage();check_usage(report["cgroup_initial"])
